notes.text: Test laziness before the first next() and between next() calls with a stateful one-shot iterator; reversed bounds must fail on first iteration even when values is empty. Independently exhaust small n against itertools.combinations and check inversion with existing nth_combination. Include empty n=0, singleton, first/last combinations, generator positions, repeated/decreasing/out-of-range indices, invalid n, floats/strings/None, and bool rejection in n and positions. Check billion-size n with short positions without invoking nth_combination on that huge range. O(k) binomial expressions are feasible; the claim concerns expression count, not constant-cost arbitrary-precision arithmetic.

Use Binding.original.line for strict diagnostics, including errors after blank lines and after multiline values; Reader marks before consuming leading multiline whitespace. Preserve that existing original-start convention rather than recomputing a physical key line. Test recovery after errors, comments/blanks, key-only versus explicit empty, repeated keys with first insertion order, BOM/CRLF, quoted/escaped/multiline values, and literal environment references.
